info.name: Garment ERP · Sales Teams
info.description: Six Team APIs in the first folder; separately identified supporting/dependent APIs in the second. Uses the fixed Admin development server4102. No role headers or fake tokens. Run seed:teams first for Merchandiser B. See sales-teams-verification.md for the blocker/reassignment/removal journey.

request.description: List summaries and live membership counts.

exec: pm.test('Request completed',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,201]));

if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data=pm.response.json().data; if(data && data.code && data.code.startsWith('TEAM-')) {pm.collectionVariables.set('teamId',data.id);pm.collectionVariables.set('teamVersion',String(data.version));}}
